An '''[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] fleet''' was located at the [[Itani Nebula/Legends|Itani Nebula]] at some [[Time/Legends|time]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. While there, the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]] fought against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in a [[Battle near the Itani Nebula|battle]].<ref name="TFU II" /> The fleet's flagship was the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']].<ref name="TFU II novel" />
